headline: Revenue grows y/y; earnings rebound but slip q/q
summary_short: Revenue was $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y but down 2.2% q/q. Net income of $57.1M reversed a $170.7M year-ago loss, though it fell 16.4% versus the prior quarter.
summary_long: Revenue was $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y but down 2.2% q/q. Gross margin was 62.1%, up from about 60.0% in Q4 FY2025 and down slightly from 62.9% a year earlier. Operating income fell 4.1% y/y and 7.7% q/q to $77.4M; EBITDA was flat y/y at $85.5M but down 10.1% q/q. Net income of $57.1M swung positive from a $170.7M year-ago loss, though down 16.4% q/q; diluted EPS was $1.09 versus a $3.17 loss per share a year earlier.
